description: Planning for the Future in a Floodplain is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by City of Fort Collins; National Weather Service. After a nightmare flood in 1997, Fort Collins, Colorado, stepped up efforts to improve resilience in the face of extreme events, efforts that will also serve the community well if climate change leads to heavier rainstorms. Coverage: Colorado (2015). The toolkit gives Colorado as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
